title: Claude plugin installation can resolve a pinned SHA to an attacker-controlled branch
summary: Claude Code's plugin installer could select a branch named like the pinned commit instead of the reviewed commit. The advisory also names Claude Desktop's installation flow, but gives no separate Desktop fixed version.

severity.rationale: Installing a malicious plugin from a Git host that permits SHA-shaped branch names can bypass the integrity pin. This supply chain precondition limits reach while exposing coding-agent execution.

affected.note: Named in the advisory; no separate fixed version specified.

exposure: Requires an attacker-controlled plugin repository, installation pinned to a safe hash and a host allowing 40-character SHA-shaped branches.

params.instructions: Check Claude Desktop updates separately; this advisory does not map the plugin fix to a Desktop version.

remediation.details: Update Claude Code to 2.1.179 or later. Use vendor updates for Desktop.
remediation.risk: Low. Validate plugin installation after updating.

verification: Confirm the installed Claude Code version meets the fixed floor.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
